tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i tsha chog 'gro kun thar pa 'dren pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ga ga na ma n+ya siddha bai ro tsa nā ya/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /bla ma rnam snang che la gus btud nas/ /ma gyur 'gro ba'i sdig pa sbyong slad du/ /sātstsha'i cho ga mkhas pa'i gzhung bzhin bshad/ /'dir sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs rnams nyams su len pa'i gang zag rnams la nye bar mkho ba tsha chog gi lag len 'bri ba la don gsum te/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ ro sregs te sdig pa sbyang ba'i bar rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab gsal byed gyi yi ge rnams dang phyag len rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas rtogs par byas la/ thal ba bsdu ba'i tshe'ang bdag bskyed bsdus pa tsam zhig sngon du 'gro ba'i mjug gi mchod bstod rdzogs nas rang nyid thab drung du song la/ mtheb srin gyi se gol dang bcas oṃ badzra muḥthab kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ zhes brjod la ro khang bshig nas rus pa rnams rtogs pa zhib pos bsdus la sngar nas sgrub zin pa'i bum chus khrus gsol rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa bya/ de nas rtsa rig bzlas bzhin pa'i rus pa rnams shin tu zhib par brdung la 'jim pa gtsang ma dang rin po che sna lnga sogs gang 'dzom bsres pa la bum pa'i chu blugs la sgrub pa'i tshe rtsa rig dang sbyong rgyal gyi sngags bzlas/ rang nyid bdag bskyed de ga'i mu'am zhag gi bar chod nas bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan/ sor mo lhag ma gsum brkyang ba'i steng du 'jim pa bzhag g.yas de dang 'dra bas steng nas bkab la ngag tu/ 'jim pa'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga te zhes sogs rtsa rig tshar gnyis brjod la/

de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'od zer lnga'i rnam pas spyan drangs te sngags phreng la thim/ sngags phreng 'od du zhu nas 'jim pa la thim pas/ 'jim pa ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi ye shes lnga'i phung por gyur/ zhes brjod la gong du rin po che ma bsres na skabs 'dir rin chen bdar rgyu bdar la rtsa rig mang du bzlas la/ sātstsha ji ltar rigs pa dang gzhan yang bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems sogs dang rang gang la mos pa de btab la/ snyam zhing chu'i skyon mi yong ba byas nas tshon rtsi rgyas par 'bul/ sātstsha'i nang du bzhugs rgyu'i sngags ni/ durba'i shuddhe bi shuddhe/ zhes pa yan bris pa'i rjes su dmigs yul gyi mi rgya bod gang rung gi skad kyis bris pa'i mthar/ sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi shuddhe swāhā/ zhes bris la dri bzang dang byin rlabs kyi khu bas byugs nas dbu nas sgril ba gang mang dang / gzhan gzungs sngags byin rlabs can 'jug thub na'ang legs/ zhabs bsdoms 'thas par phul la rab gnas rgyas bsdus gang rung mtshan nyid dang ldan par bya/ dmigs bsal gyi rab gnas sam byin gyis brlabs pa'i cho ga ni/ gnas dben par stegs la sogs pa rten bzhugs 'os pa'i sar sātstsha rnams shin tu mang bar yod na gru bzhi zlum po gang rung gis gral byas pa'i mthar/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer mchod g.yas skor dang / sātstsha nyung ngu las med na ji ltar rigs pa bzhugs su gsol ba'i drung du mchod pa sbreng tshar bya zhing cha gsum gtor ma'ang bsham mo/ /sgrub pa po rnams kyi mdun du rdo dril 'thor nas rnams sta gon bya'o/ /dang po ni mchod pa rnams yakṣas bsangs/ dzwa la a nas sbyangs/ swa bhā was stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i sogs dkyil chog bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs bya/

skyabs 'gro bsdus pa'i dmigs pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge'i khri pad zla la bla ma rnam par snang mdzad bzhugs pa'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs bla ma sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsam pa'i drung du/ bdag dang dmigs yul gyis thogs drangs sems can rnams 'khod nas skyabs 'gro byed par bsam la/ dmigs yul gyis gtso byas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs skyabs 'gro ji ltar rigs pa dang / bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs skyabs gsol gyi tshig chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa sogs dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje sngon du 'gro bas sems bskyed/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis snod bcud stong par sbyangs nas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ ljang sngon de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog ljang sngon zhi ba'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ de'i snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa la bdag nyid khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba dbu mtha' yas pa/ phyag mtha' yas pa sku mdog sngon po sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ phyag lhag ma rnams kyis ral gri la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs dang / rgyu ma dang mgo thod sha yis gang ba bsnams pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod la hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badzra satwa kro dha sogs lan gsum gyis lus ngag yid bsrung bar bsam la gnas gsum du reg

yang lan gsum brjod la sa gzhi phyogs mtshams steng rnams su bskor bas rdo rje'i sa gzhir rwa drwa gur me ri dang bcas par bsam la yang snying gar lan gsum bcas la sngags brjod pas sgor bsrung bar bsam/ de nas rang gi lag mthil gnyis su a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re de dag gi dbus su hūm̐ dang a zhes pa nas bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi bstod pa rdzogs pa'i bar dkyil chog bzhin byas la/ sātstsha rnams badzra yakṣas bsangs/ shu n+yā tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sātstsha'i grangs mnyam pa'i steng du sātstsha rnams rin po che las grub pa'i sprul pa'i mchod rten tshad dang mtshan nyid rgyan la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa'i bum pa'i nang du dbus su seng ge'i khri/ shar du glang po che'i khri sogs nas/ 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi gnas su padma dang zla ba'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ oṃ sarba bid sarba a ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ne ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad sogs nas rdo rje 'bebs pa'i bar sngags dang sa bon las bskyed pa khyad par tsam ma gtogs bum bskyed bzhin spyan 'dren rgyas btab dbang bskur ba'i bar bum bskyed bzhin byas la gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs sngags tshar gcig brjod la/ rtsa rig de las 'od zer 'phros pas spyir sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ bye brag tu yang ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ khyad par du yang dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ slar 'dus mdun bskyed kyi thugs kha'i yig 'bru rnams la thim par gyur/ zhes brjod la durga brgya stong khri la sogs pa bzlas pa'i rjes su/

oṃ sarba bid sarba a wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ nas/ oṃ badzra a be sha ya a'i bar ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag dang dmigs yul gyis thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod la/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs byas pa'i rjes su/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho mas phul ba'i mthar/ bstod pa bum bskyed bzhin cha gsum gtor ma btang ba'i rjes su/ ye dhar tshar gsum/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag du yang thugs rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung bzhis gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang dmigs yul gyis thog drangs sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod la dril gsil rol mo dang bcas pas me tog gtor/ ye dhar dang su pra tiṣṭha gang mang brjod pa lan gsum byas pa'i rjes su/ mchod rten lha dang bcas pa zhu ba las byung ba'i sātstsha'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod la mchod pa kha gsos bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs/ gtsang zhing gtsang la sogs dkyil chog gi mjug chog bzhin phul la/ shes na bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad kyi bstod pa sogs mchod rten gyi bstod pa rgyas pa rnams dang / mi shes pa'i bsdus pa la dga' na/ sna tshogs padma zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /sna tshogs rin chen khams las grub pa yi/ /sprul pa'i mchod rten sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/

/chos sku'i rang bzhin can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang / /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su yang / /skur bcas sku ni med pa yi/ /mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa sogs shlauai ka gcig de nas bzang spyod sogs smon lam gang shes bton la rjes kyi cho ga ni/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐ sogs kyis dbang bskur/ oṃ bhri ta sogs kyis rgyas btab/ badzra satwa kro dha/ phyag rgya dang bcas pa lan gsum gyis bsrungs la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /brgyud 'debs dang bkra shis gsung rgyun phyag len bzhin bya'o/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyis durga nyis 'bum ma song gi bar la grangs bsags/ yang bsdus pa la dga' na bdag bskyed gong bzhin la/ mchod pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ sogs sngags tsam dang bstod pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang / /phyag 'tshal rdo rje sems dpa' la'o/ /zhes pa tsam dang bum pa'i nang du lha sngags bskyed pa ni/ rnam snang / sbyong rgyal/ rgyal mchog shākya rig dbang / me tog cher rgyas rnams bskyed la spyan 'dren sogs cho ga lhag ma rnams bya zhing / mchod pa'ang sngags tsam dang / bstod pa/ chos dbyings ye shes nas/ me tog cher rgyas la phyag 'tshal bar bya ba tsam khyad par ro/ /yang cho ga 'di dang 'dabs 'brel du bla ma yi dam sogs kyi sku la rab gnas byed dgos tshe rab gnas kyi gzhung bzhin so so'i bskyed dang bstod pa spyan dbye sogs bya/ sātstsha'i rab gnas shin tu bsdus par 'dod na/ rang nyid thun mtshams kyi lha gang rung gi nga rgyal gyis thog mar/ sumbha nis bgegs bskrad/ ji ltar bltams pa dang / de dag sku la sogs shlau ka gnyis kyis khrus dang sku phyi bya/

swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du/ oṃ las rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rten mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i bum pa'i nang du pad zla'i gdan lnga la/ dbus su rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ shar du mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon mnyam bzhag lhor rin 'byung ser po mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam bzhag byang du don yod grub pa ljang gu skyabs sbyin mnyam bzhag thams cad kyang dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa 'khor bcas oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dbu brgyan/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pādyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhūpe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai widya/ shapta aḥhūm̐/ chos sku nam mkha' sogs shlau ka gcig oṃ tsakṣu tsakṣu sa manta tsakṣu bi shu dha ne swāhā/ spyan dbye/ ye dharmā brjod cing 'bru yang yang gtor ba'i mthar gong bzhin mchod/ sna tshogs padma sogs kyis bstod/ bkra shis gang shes bya ba ni bsdus pa'o/ /yang bsdu gzhan thams cad la/ pad zla'i steng du rdo rje sems dpar bskyed la de'i bstod pa dang / brtan bzhugs kyi rjes su zhal sgyur bya ba tsam ma gtogs gzhan gong bzhin no/ /zhes ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i sdig sbyong gi cho ga rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i tsha chog logs su phyung ba 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rje btsun rin po che'i dgongs pa bzhin thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog

(12) lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i ro sreg gi cho ga las nag 'gros bklag chog mar bkod pa 'di yang / bka' drin can gyi ma drung bsod nams dpal gyi dbang mo sogs dmigs yul rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslang ste rang dang skal mnyam gyi don du bris pa lags// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ tsha chog 'gro kun thar pa 'dren pa'i lcags kyu/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
